description: This Java interface defines a builder for creating responses to 'RetrieveThings' commands in a live signals query context within Eclipse Ditto. It includes an internal factory interface for generating successful response objects based on retrieved 'Thing' instances, optionally filtered by a predicate.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses related to the RetrieveThings command, extending a generic query command response step.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Nested interface designed as a factory to create success responses containing retrieved 'Thing' objects, with optional field filtering via a predicate.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a success response containing 'Thing' objects retrieved by the RetrieveThings command, filtered by a given predicate.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a success response containing 'Thing' objects retrieved by the RetrieveThings command without additional filtering.
